notices.title: Gears of War: E-Day review — terrific shooting buoys a sluggish campaign
notices.contentSnippet: Gears has never felt better to play, or more creatively stagnant.

notices.title: Warhorse co-founder believes 'AI is not a get out of jail free card' and that execs have a 'simplified mental model' of what it means for games
notices.contentSnippet: Wish for both quantity and quality.

notices.title: Gundam Rogue Orbit gave me a sick whip sword, but held back the one thing I want most in a mech game
notices.contentSnippet: Let me put my own parts on my Gundam, dangit!

notices.title: Warhammer Survivors is more than just a Vampire Survivors spin-off
notices.contentSnippet: Even as we drown in Warhammer games, Survivors stands out as something extremely cool.

notices.title: Deadlock isn't a MOBA or a third-person shooter anymore—City Never Sleeps has turned it into a horror game
notices.contentSnippet: Can't a little guy find some peace in the tunnels?

notices.title: Exclusive – Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy will let you be a crooked cop, pinning crimes on the innocent, or follow in good boy Gregor Eisenhorn's footsteps
Despite the tragic death of its lead writer, one of the scariest games I have ever played will finally come out later this month
notices.contentSnippet: Divine Frequency launches in early access on October 27 with "70%" of the final game ready to play.

notices.title: Steam sale deep cut alert: this ARPG originally developed for Nokia N-Gage is brilliant on Deck
notices.contentSnippet: Xanadu Next isn't amazing, but it's endlessly charming.

notices.title: Industry layoff watch: Supermassive, Ninja Theory, The Coalition, and a warning from Warhorse
notices.contentSnippet: No layoffs have been announced for The Coalition, but some Gears of War: E-Day developers are worried they'll be next, even if the game succeeds.

notices.title: Despite calling Grand Theft Auto 'a videogame franchise built around criminal activity,' Miami-Dade sheriff isn't mad about the NBA's 'Vice City' transformation
notices.contentSnippet: Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz says her strong stance against the GTA 6 promotional collaboration was only about "publicly owned facilities and infrastructure."

notices.title: The final showdown: Motion blur vs chromatic aberration
notices.contentSnippet: Only one can be crowned the worst graphical effect in games. You decide.

notices.title: Capcom's remake machine is ticking away, only problem is that means revisiting Resident Evil 5 and 6
notices.contentSnippet: Some things are better left alone, although I'm happy to be proven wrong.
